channel.title: ScriptureStudy Pro™ news
channel.description: Announcements from Studio Graphē One for ScriptureStudy Pro™.

item.title: Don't forget to update to the latest version now. Another update is on its way!
item.description:
The coming update includes two bundled KJV StudioOneEditions Bibles. The Original is the text you know. The new edition is a sensitive modernisation, not a new translation: old verb endings and pronouns are brought up to date, and the words whose meaning have been lost are replaced. The KJV translators syntax and cadence stay. Thee and thou remain where God is addressed; poetry keeps its metre. Strong’s numbers linked to every word. The CBSC bundled commentary has had a substantial rework: modern language throughout. More tappable verse references.

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.

item.title: Update
item.description:
There's a new update for you. The update is for iOS devices.

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.

item.title: A bit of a delay in the iOS update!
item.description:
Thank you for your patience. There's been a bit of a delay in the iOS update due to unexpected technical problems. It will be with you soon, we promise! We have also fixed problems with the bundled Cambridge Bible for Schools and Colleges commentary. There were missing verses, especially in the first 19 chapters of Exodus. Tapping and navigating to verses was problematic also. The commentary update will go out to macOS too.

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.

item.title: The update is winging its way to you now!
item.description:
You will be alerted when it's in the Store. This update also includes 21 new languages bringing the total language support to 46 languages! This is a ministry, not a marketing strategy. My aim is to reach as many people groups as possible. If you prefer to wait for the new release of the Microsoft Windows and Android versions, then those will serve many more language groups. ScriptureStudy Pro for Windows will serve 110 languages and Android can reach 86 language groups. Matt 24v14: "And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations".

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.

item.title: We apologise for the delay!
item.description:
A big update to ScriptureStudy Pro™ is on its way to the App Store in days. Thank you for your patience. The Online Catalogue is now in basic and full, so you can download modules without upgrading. The Encyclopedia has been rebuilt with many more articles and links to Strong’s. The Companion Panel is a tap away on iPhone and iPad,.Plus many bug fixes, lots of polish, and updated help in every language. Your experience as a user will feel elevated and more tightly integrated. You will be notified as soon as it arrives in the store.

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.

item.title: Notes are back on iPhone and iPad
item.description:
Notes are back on iPhone and iPad. Write a note on the Desk, open it beside any verse in the Companion panel, and find it again with search.

On iPhone and iPad notes are plain text. A note you formatted on your Mac opens to read, marked with a small (i); edit it on the Mac and its formatting stays intact.

Notes sync with your Mac through iCloud. Update to version 2.3.3 to use them.

For macOS, iPhone and iPad only.
